talentInfo.title: Regenerative Microbes
talentInfo.description: Symbiote's Carapace heals the target for 68 (+4% per level) Health per second over 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Locust Brood
talentInfo.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

talentInfo.title: Pressurized Glands
talentInfo.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Reinforced Carapace
talentInfo.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Envenomed Nest
talentInfo.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Adrenal Overload
talentInfo.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

talentInfo.title: Sustained Carapace
talentInfo.description: Increases the Shield amount of Symbiote's Carapace by 40% and allows it to persist after Symbiote ends.

talentInfo.title: Needlespine
talentInfo.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Ballistospores
talentInfo.description: Increases Toxic Nest's range to global and increases duration by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Prolific Dispersal
talentInfo.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

talentInfo.title: Networked Carapace
talentInfo.description: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

talentInfo.title: Calldown: MULE
talentInfo.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Vile Nest
talentInfo.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Evolve Monstrosity
talentInfo.description: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.  Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

talentInfo.title: Ultimate Evolution
talentInfo.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

talentInfo.title: Bombard Strain
talentInfo.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and they now lose health 40% more slowly.

talentInfo.title: Soma Transference
talentInfo.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

talentInfo.title: Spatial Efficiency
talentInfo.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Adrenaline Boost
talentInfo.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Survival Instincts
talentInfo.description: Reduce damage taken by Locusts from non-Heroes by 50% and increase their damage by 60%.

talentInfo.title: Envenomed Spikes
talentInfo.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Volatile Mutation
talentInfo.description: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal 137 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for 100% of the damage dealt.

talentInfo.title: Hivemind
talentInfo.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

talentInfo.title: Locust Nest
talentInfo.description: Activate to create a nest that periodically spawns Locusts. Only one Locust Nest can be active at a time.

talentInfo.title: Evolution Complete
talentInfo.description: Increase Monstrosity's Basic Attack damage by 100%.

talentInfo.title: Evolutionary Link
talentInfo.description: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%. As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Extended Lightning
talentInfo.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%.  Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.  Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

talentInfo.title: Negatively Charged
talentInfo.description: Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.  Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

talentInfo.title: Applied Force
talentInfo.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

talentInfo.title: Hindered Motion
talentInfo.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Counter-Strike
talentInfo.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Deadly Charge
talentInfo.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

talentInfo.title: Pure Malice
talentInfo.description: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

talentInfo.title: Lightning Barrage
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

talentInfo.title: Hasty Bargain
talentInfo.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

talentInfo.title: Might of the Highlord
talentInfo.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

talentInfo.title: Wrath of the Highlord
talentInfo.description: If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds.  If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

talentInfo.title: Circle of Life
talentInfo.description: Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.  Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.  Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

talentInfo.title: Flames of Fury
talentInfo.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.  Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.  Mythic Quest: After hitting 30 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.

talentInfo.title: Live and Let Live
talentInfo.description: While above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.  Dragonqueen: While above 75% Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges 25% faster.

talentInfo.title: Surge of Vitality
talentInfo.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Heat Exhaustion
talentInfo.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

talentInfo.title: Lifeblossom
talentInfo.description: While above 75% Health, casting Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location, Breath of Life instead removes Slows and Roots from the target.  After collecting a Lifeblossom, the next Gift of Life costs no Health.  Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

talentInfo.title: Fire Within
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Verdant Flourish
talentInfo.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

talentInfo.title: Cleansing Flame
talentInfo.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.  2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

talentInfo.title: Life-Binder
talentInfo.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.  Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

talentInfo.title: Life Unbound
talentInfo.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.  Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

talentInfo.title: Dragon Scales
talentInfo.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Pacify
talentInfo.description: Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Draconic Discipline
talentInfo.description: Increase Dragonqueen Basic Attack healing by  50%. For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen Basic Attacks, reduce Preservation's cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Overprotective
talentInfo.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of the amount healed.

talentInfo.title: Tough Love
talentInfo.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

talentInfo.title: On Ruby Wings
talentInfo.description: Healing or damaging 3 or more Heroes with a single Cleansing Flame fireball causes that fireball to not be consumed.

talentInfo.title: Ancient Flame
talentInfo.description: While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet. This does not grant Quest stacks.  Passive: Dragonqueen grants 25% more maxium Health.

talentInfo.title: Ritual of Life
talentInfo.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Immortal Coil

talentInfo.title: Army of Hell

talentInfo.title: Hellforged Armor
talentInfo.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and lose 25% less health per second.

talentInfo.title: Art of Chaos
talentInfo.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.

talentInfo.title: Infernus
talentInfo.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%. Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

talentInfo.title: Skyfall
talentInfo.description: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing 58 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area. Has 3 charges.  If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Firestorm
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by 3 seconds. When Deathwing lands, he drops 7 meteors near the landing area, dealing 77 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.  Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

talentInfo.title: Bellowing Roar
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Destroyer: The bite from Onslaught now Slows by 60% for 1.5 seconds.  World Breaker: Reduce Earth Shatter's cooldown by 6 seconds and its Energy cost by 10.

talentInfo.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10. After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Fire and Fury
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Rooted, Slowed, or Stunned enemy Heroes deal 40% additional damage and reduce the cooldowns of Deathwing's Basic Abilities by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 30% of Deathwing's missing Health for 8 seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second. talentInfo.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

talentInfo.title: Lorenado
talentInfo.description: Vector Targeting After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.

talentInfo.title: Super Healing Potion
talentInfo.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.  Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

talentInfo.title: Ancient Blessings
talentInfo.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 (+4% per level) damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

talentInfo.title: Horadric Staff
talentInfo.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Safety in Numbers
talentInfo.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

talentInfo.title: Scroll of Stone Curse
talentInfo.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Bottomless Flask
talentInfo.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Morenados!
talentInfo.description: Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Field Study
level_one.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

level_four.title: Ruby
level_four.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level_seven.title: Cube Mastery
level_seven.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Constriction
talentInfo.description: Increases Drag duration by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Tissue Regeneration
talentInfo.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

talentInfo.title: Enhanced Agility
talentInfo.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

talentInfo.title: One-Who-Collects
talentInfo.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

talentInfo.title: Lurker Strain
talentInfo.description: Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Feeding Frenzy
talentInfo.description: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.  Gambit: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Every death reduces this cooldown reduction by 0.25 seconds, up to 3 times.

talentInfo.title: Symbiosis
talentInfo.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Isolation
talentInfo.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Adaptation
talentInfo.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

talentInfo.title: Primal Rage
talentInfo.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage per Essence stored.

talentInfo.title: Ferocious Stalker
talentInfo.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 50% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

talentInfo.title: Tunneling Claws
talentInfo.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

talentInfo.title: Elongated Tongue
talentInfo.description: Increase Drag range by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Pack Leader
talentInfo.description: Dehaka gains 40 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 4 seconds after leaving.

talentInfo.title: Contagion
talentInfo.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target, but it deals 60% less damage to all targets.

talentInfo.title: Essence Claws
talentInfo.description: Dehaka's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1 second. If the target is a Hero, Dehaka gains 5 Essence.

talentInfo.title: Change Is Survival
talentInfo.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Devil's Due
talentInfo.description: Black Soulstone increases the effects of Regen Globes and Healing Fountains by 2.25% per Soul.

talentInfo.title: Feast on Fear
talentInfo.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower heals Diablo for 10% of his maximum Health over 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Soul Shield
talentInfo.description: Activate to gain 25 plus 50% of Diablo's current Souls as Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Every time Diablo damages an enemy Hero, reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: From the Shadows
talentInfo.description: Increases the cast range of Shadow Charge by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Life Leech
talentInfo.description: Diablo gains 1 Soul and heals for 1.75% of his maximum Health when Basic Attacking an enemy Hero. While at 100 Souls, increase this healing to 3.5% of his maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Souls to the Flame
talentInfo.description: Fire Stomp grants 1 Soul every 3 times it damages an enemy Hero, and heals for an additional 1.3% of its damage dealt per Soul.

talentInfo.title: Demonic Strength
talentInfo.description: Once Overpower's stun expires, the target is slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Sacrificial Soul
talentInfo.description: Stunning a Hero with Shadow Charge grants 10 Souls and 20 Armor for 3 seconds. While at 100 Souls, increase this Armor to 40.

talentInfo.title: Soul Feast
talentInfo.description: Black Soulstone increases Diablo's Health Regeneration by 0.4 per second per Soul.

talentInfo.title: Eternal Flames
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Fire Stomp by 1 second. When Diablo Stuns an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower, reset the cooldown of Fire Stomp and restore 45 Mana.

talentInfo.title: Diabolical Momentum
talentInfo.description: When Diablo's Basic Attacks damage enemies, reduce the cooldown of Shadow Charge and Overpower by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Apocalypse
talentInfo.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Lightning Breath
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, become Unstoppable and Channel for up to 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies in front of Diablo. Enemies affected are Slowed by 4% for 2 seconds, up to 40%.  Lightning Breath's direction changes with your mouse cursor position.

talentInfo.title: Devastating Charge
talentInfo.description: Increase Shadow Charge's terrain collision damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit an enemy Hero against terrain 5 times.  Reward: Hitting enemy Heroes against terrain reduces their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Cruelty
talentInfo.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower increases Diablo's Attack Speed by 50% for 7 seconds, up to 100%.

talentInfo.title: Hellfire
talentInfo.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fire Stomp grants 3% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.  While at maximum stacks, Diablo deals 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

talentInfo.title: Domination
talentInfo.description: Casting Overpower resets the cooldown of Shadow Charge.

talentInfo.title: Fearful Presence
talentInfo.description: Activate to reduce the damage dealt by nearby enemy Heroes by 30% for 3 seconds. Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Diablo have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Debilitating Flames
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Fire Stomp are Slowed by 6% for 4 seconds, up to 60%. Heroes Slowed by 24% or more by Debilitating Flames deal 50% less damage.

talentInfo.title: Hellstorm
talentInfo.description: Lightning Breath lasts 200% longer.

talentInfo.title: Hellgate
talentInfo.description: Teleport and place a demonic rune at target location. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Planet Cracker

talentInfo.description: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Rough Landing
talentInfo.description: Increase Groundbreaker's Slow amount by 10% and duration by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Warbreaker
talentInfo.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Body Check
talentInfo.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Unrivaled Strength
talentInfo.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 75%.

talentInfo.title: Indomitable
talentInfo.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: In for the Kill
talentInfo.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 100%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

talentInfo.title: Thirst for Battle
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Intimidation
talentInfo.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Oppressor
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Warlord's Challenge
talentInfo.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Decimate
talentInfo.description: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.  Stores up to 3 charges.

talentInfo.title: Double Up
talentInfo.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Defensive Measures
talentInfo.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bloodcraze
talentInfo.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Mortal Combo
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

talentInfo.title: Earthshaker
talentInfo.description: Wrecking Ball Stuns enemies near the impact area for 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Seasoned Soldier
talentInfo.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

talentInfo.title: Death Wish
talentInfo.description: Increase the duration of Warlord's Challenge by 0.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is killed while Taunted by Warlord's Challenge, its cooldown is reduced by 45 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Deadly Calm
talentInfo.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Titanic Might
talentInfo.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

talentInfo.title: Inner Rage
talentInfo.description: Body Check gains an additional charge and its healing reduction is increased by an additional 45%.

talentInfo.title: Redemption
talentInfo.description: Quest: Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks.  Reward: At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

talentInfo.title: Target Practice
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

talentInfo.title: Serrated Arrows
talentInfo.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talentInfo.title: Explosive Arrows
talentInfo.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

talentInfo.title: Ignore All Distractions
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Never Outmatched
talentInfo.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Sharpened Arrowheads
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

talentInfo.title: The Dragon Hungers
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

talentInfo.title: Dragonstrike
talentInfo.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

talentInfo.title: Dragon's Arrow
talentInfo.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Mounted Archery
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds. Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

talentInfo.title: Ninja Assassin
talentInfo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Fleet of Foot
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

talentInfo.title: Piercing Arrows
talentInfo.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

talentInfo.title: Giant Slayer
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 1.6% of their maximum Health as damage.

talentInfo.title: Flawless Technique
talentInfo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow increases the damage of Hanzo's next Basic Attack within 5 seconds by 40%. Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the damage of Hanzo's next Storm Bow within 5 seconds by 40%.

talentInfo.title: The Dragon Awakens
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow, Scatter Arrow, or Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Dragonstrike by 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Perfect Agility
talentInfo.description: Natural Agility gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bullseye
talentInfo.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Play of the Game
talentInfo.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. talentInfo.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

talentInfo.title: Hogger's Joggers
talentInfo.description: While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.  When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

talentInfo.title: Brute Force
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 25% and its damage by 50%.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 6 damage.

talentInfo.title: Garbage Fire
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Seeing Red
talentInfo.description: While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.

talentInfo.title: Dense Blasting Powder
talentInfo.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.  Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

talentInfo.title: Hoardapult
talentInfo.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds. talentInfo.title: Pummel
talentInfo.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.  Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Gain 25 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 4 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

level_sixteen.description: Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%.  Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

level_twenty.title: No Control
level_twenty.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

level_one.title: On The Prowl
level_one.description: Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 7 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

level_four.title: Hogger's Joggers
level_four.description: While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.  When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

level_seven.title: Garbage Fire
level_seven.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.

level_ten.title: Shockwave
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Dust Devil
level_thirteen.description: Gain 25 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 4 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Headbanger
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: No Control

talentInfo.title: Burn The Impure
talentInfo.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Impaling Light
talentInfo.description: Celestial Charge deals 150% more damage to Heroes, reduced by 25% for each additional Hero hit. For each Valorous Brand on the target when Celestial Charge's Stun completes, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.  Passive: Reduce Celestial Charge's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and its Mana cost from 40 to 30.

talentInfo.title: Sovereign Armor
talentInfo.description: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Molten Armor extends the duration of this Armor by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Battle Hunger
talentInfo.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

talentInfo.title: Press Forward
talentInfo.description: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe. Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

talentInfo.title: Holy Fervor
talentInfo.description: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

talentInfo.title: Flash of Anger
talentInfo.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Angelic Armaments
talentInfo.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

talentInfo.title: Wrath of the Angiris
talentInfo.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.  After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Divine Rage
talentInfo.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Pathetic Mortals
talentInfo.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Melting Touch
talentInfo.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Celestial Swiftness
talentInfo.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

talentInfo.title: Heavenly Host
talentInfo.description: Shields granted by Angelic Armaments no longer expire, and on initial activation, nearby allied Heroes gain a Shield that absorbs 600 (+4% per level) damage.  If a Shield granted to an allied Hero lasts 3 seconds, it fires 1 sword at a nearby enemy, prioritizing closest Heroes, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

talentInfo.description: Frostbolt will now pierce the first two targets.

talentInfo.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes 12 times with Concussion Mine.  Reward: Concussion Mine deals 40% more damage and knocks enemies back 30% farther.

talentInfo.title: Bouncy Bouncy
talentInfo.description: Upon colliding with terrain for the first time, Frag Launcher grenades deal 20% more damage.

talentInfo.title: Tricky Shuffles
talentInfo.description: While Frag Launcher has no charges left, Junkrat gains 10% Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks deal 15% bonus damage.

talentInfo.title: Extra-Wound Timers
talentInfo.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

talentInfo.title: Blow 'Em Up!
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Taste For Explosions
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

talentInfo.title: Chattering Teeth
talentInfo.description: Steel Traps will slowly chase nearby enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: BOOM POW
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Sticky Wicket
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Dirty Trickster
talentInfo.description: Increase the explosion radius of Total Mayhem by 20%. When Junkrat is Stunned, Rooted, or damaged by an enemy Hero while below 50% Health, he uses Total Mayhem, dropping 5 grenades at his feet that explode.  This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Bogged Down
talentInfo.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

talentInfo.title: Rocket Ride
talentInfo.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.  After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

talentInfo.title: RIP-Tire
talentInfo.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

talentInfo.title: RIP-Tire
talentInfo.description: Create a motorized bomb with 500 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 450, 600, or 750 (+4% per level) damage to enemies depending on how close they are to the center of the blast (with the highest amount near the center).

talentInfo.title: Ripper Air
talentInfo.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

talentInfo.title: Gotta Trap 'Em All!
talentInfo.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

talentInfo.title: Bombs Away

talentInfo.title: Spread Volley
talentInfo.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

talentInfo.title: Endless Nades
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Burst Fire
talentInfo.description: Frag Launcher fires all of its charges in a continuous burst, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, but it loses 1 maximum charge.

talentInfo.title: Cannonball!
talentInfo.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

talentInfo.description: Junkrat also gains the Ability RIP-Tire. Each time he uses his Heroic, it swaps to the alternate ability.  Passive: Reduce both Heroic cooldowns by 20 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Decreases Radiant Dash's cooldown by 2 seconds and increases the maximum number of charges by 1.

talentInfo.title: Quicksilver
talentInfo.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally gives Kharazim and the target 30% bonus Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Cleansing Touch
talentInfo.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally makes them Unstoppable for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Echo of Heaven

talentInfo.title: Epiphany
talentInfo.description: Activate to restore 70% of Kharazim's maximum Mana and refill 2 charges of Radiant Dash.

talentInfo.description: Unlock the Medivac Dropship and Reinforcements abilities. These abilities share a cooldown.  Medivac Dropship Target a location for a Medivac transport. After 10 seconds, or when the Ability is activated again, the Medivac will travel to the original cast location to unload its passengers.

talentInfo.title: Hippity Hop
talentInfo.description: After not Basic Attacking or taking damage for 2 seconds, increase the Move Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness by 10%.

talentInfo.title: Natural Perspective
talentInfo.description: Nature's Toxin reveals enemies for its duration.

talentInfo.title: Sentinel Wisp
talentInfo.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

talentInfo.title: Blossom Swell
talentInfo.description: Increases Noxious Blossom's cast range by 25%. and its radius by 20%. Blossom Swell applies 1 additional stack of Nature's Toxin to enemies hit.

talentInfo.title: Siphoning Toxin
talentInfo.description: While at least one enemy is afflicted by Nature's Toxin, heal for 9 (+4% per level) per second. When an enemy Hero has 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin, increase this healing by 19 (+4% per level) per second.

talentInfo.title: Wild Vigor
talentInfo.description: Using Crippling Spores increases the damage of Lunara's next 4 Basic Attacks by 70%.

talentInfo.title: Choking Pollen
talentInfo.description: Noxious Blossom deals 100% more damage to enemies afflicted by Nature's Toxin, increased to 175% against enemies with 3 stacks.

talentInfo.title: Splintered Spear
talentInfo.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

talentInfo.title: Leaping Strike
talentInfo.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

talentInfo.title: Thornwood Vine
talentInfo.description: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

talentInfo.title: Greater Spell Shield
talentInfo.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 75 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

talentInfo.title: Abolish Magic
talentInfo.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

talentInfo.title: Let Them Wither
talentInfo.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

talentInfo.title: Star Wood Spear
talentInfo.description: Increase Lunara's Basic Attack range by 0.5. Using Crippling Spores increases Lunara's Basic Attack range by an additional 2.25 for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Unfair Advantage
talentInfo.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

talentInfo.title: Boundless Stride
talentInfo.description: All Leaping Strike charges are returned every 15 seconds. Leaping Strike can be used on allies.

talentInfo.title: For the Wildlands
talentInfo.description: Thornwood Vine shoots 4 additional vines in an arc.

talentInfo.title: Party Mix
talentInfo.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.  Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Accelerando
talentInfo.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

talentInfo.title: Smooth Moves
talentInfo.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.  Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Supersonic
talentInfo.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

talentInfo.title: Off the Wall
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

talentInfo.title: Reverse Amp
talentInfo.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.  This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

talentInfo.title: Sound Barrier
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: High Five
talentInfo.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Heavy Casters
talentInfo.description: Push Off no longer Slows the first Hero hit, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Slip
talentInfo.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Rejuvenescência
talentInfo.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

talentInfo.title: Bossa Nova
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: House Party
talentInfo.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

talentInfo.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Naisha's Memento
talentInfo.description: Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.  Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

talentInfo.title: Pin Down
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.  Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%.  Reward: Each additional time 3 enemy Heroes are hit by a single Fan of Knives, gain an additional 5% damage, up to 50%.  Reward: Hit 4 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives to instantly gain all Rewards.

talentInfo.title: Elune's Wrath
talentInfo.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77 (+4% per level) damage when it impacts.

talentInfo.title: Ruthless Spirit
talentInfo.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

talentInfo.title: Warden's Cage
talentInfo.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Containment Disc
talentInfo.description: Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.  Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

talentInfo.title: Chain Gang
talentInfo.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Armor
talentInfo.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

talentInfo.title: Bladed Armor
talentInfo.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

talentInfo.title: Vengeful Knives
talentInfo.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

talentInfo.title: Cruel Chain
talentInfo.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
talentInfo.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance.  Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
talentInfo.description: Activate to deal 75 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.  Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

level_twenty.description: Poly Bomb now hits an area, instantly Polymorphing enemy Heroes, hitting the same area again 1 second later.  Poly Bomb's duration is reduced to 1 second, and the spread radius is increased by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Ice Storm
talentInfo.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 (+4% per level) damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

talentInfo.title: Heat Transfer
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Cold Front
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds. If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

talentInfo.title: Crystallize
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

talentInfo.title: Skating Away
talentInfo.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Induce Hibernation
talentInfo.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Backup Battery
talentInfo.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

talentInfo.title: Avalanche
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

talentInfo.title: Ice Wall
talentInfo.description: Vector Targeting After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Cooling Servos
talentInfo.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Polar Vortex
talentInfo.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Flurry
talentInfo.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

talentInfo.title: Black Ice
talentInfo.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

talentInfo.title: Acclimation
talentInfo.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Flash Freeze
talentInfo.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: The Big One
talentInfo.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

talentInfo.title: Cascade
talentInfo.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shatter
talentInfo.description: When Ice Wall expires, trapped enemy Heroes hit take 210 (+4% per level) damage and have their Armor reduced by 25 for 5 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 (+4% per level) bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

talentInfo.title: Unyielding Power
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Skull Missile.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100.  Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

talentInfo.title: Static Barrier
talentInfo.description: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Spite
talentInfo.description: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 100%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Hateful Mending
talentInfo.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Frost Storm
talentInfo.description: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

talentInfo.title: Trickery
talentInfo.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.  If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

talentInfo.title: Durance of Hate
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.  Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Consume Souls
talentInfo.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shard of Hate
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

talentInfo.title: Abhorred Skull
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

talentInfo.title: Static Field
talentInfo.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Lightning Reaction
talentInfo.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

talentInfo.title: Mimic
talentInfo.description: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

talentInfo.title: Unspeakable Horror
talentInfo.description: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

level_four.title: Static Barrier

talentInfo.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

talentInfo.title: Third Wind
talentInfo.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

talentInfo.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Dwarf Block

talentInfo.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

talentInfo.title: Thunder Burn
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Sledgehammer
talentInfo.description: Storm Bolt deals 500% damage to non-Heroic enemies.  Stormbolt cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Heavy Impact
talentInfo.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Skullcracker
talentInfo.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Perfect Storm
talentInfo.description: Storm Bolt's cooldown is reset and 25 Mana is refunded if an enemy dies within 3 seconds of being hit by it. This effect has an 8.5 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Avatar
talentInfo.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Haymaker
talentInfo.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

talentInfo.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Thunder Strike
talentInfo.description: Thunder Clap deals 200% more damage if only one target is hit.  Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Healing Static

talentInfo.title: Stoneform

talentInfo.title: Grand Slam
talentInfo.description: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

talentInfo.title: Unstoppable Force

talentInfo.title: Egg Hunt
talentInfo.description: Activate to place a fake Egg. If the fake Egg dies, it casts an untalented Slime. Maximum 3 fake Eggs.  Passive: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky Stealth for 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Fish Eye
talentInfo.description: Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.  Passive: Increase the Egg's Health by 100%, its sight radius by 300%, and it reveals all enemies in its sight radius.

talentInfo.title: Tufferfish
talentInfo.description: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

talentInfo.title: Slime Time
talentInfo.description: Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed.  Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125.  Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

talentInfo.title: Living the Dream
talentInfo.description: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

talentInfo.title: Slippery When Wet
talentInfo.description: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Time to Krill
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 (+4% per level) damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

talentInfo.title: Black Lagoon
talentInfo.description: Increase Slime's radius by 30%.

talentInfo.title: Octo-Grab
talentInfo.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

talentInfo.title: March of the Murlocs
talentInfo.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

talentInfo.title: Rejuvenating Bubble
talentInfo.description: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Fish Tank
talentInfo.description: Murky is healed for 20% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

talentInfo.title: Fish Oil
talentInfo.description: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

talentInfo.title: Toxic Buildup
talentInfo.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

talentInfo.title: Wrath of Cod
talentInfo.description: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 16% of their maximum Health over 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Big Tuna Kahuna
talentInfo.description: Murky's maximum Health and Egg respawn time are doubled.

talentInfo.title: Making Inky
talentInfo.description: Reduces the cooldown of Slime by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Thing of the Deep
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.  Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.  Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

talentInfo.title: Big Voodoo
talentInfo.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

talentInfo.title: Dead Rush
talentInfo.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies, losing Health over 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Ravenous Spirit
talentInfo.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Gargantuan
talentInfo.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Ice Block
talentInfo.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Guardian Toads

level_four.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

level_seven.title: Tower Defense
level_seven.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

level_ten.title: Pylon Overcharge
level_ten.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

level_thirteen.title: Shield Battery
level_thirteen.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 (+4% per level) Shields per second, up to 112 (+4% per level). Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

level_sixteen.title: Quantum Entanglement
level_sixteen.description: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

level_twenty.title: Construct Additional Pylons
level_twenty.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Maximum Effort
talentInfo.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Finishing Touch
talentInfo.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Fatal Wounds
talentInfo.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 70% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.

talentInfo.title: Upstage
talentInfo.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Ensnaring Swing
talentInfo.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: The Thirst
talentInfo.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

talentInfo.title: Siphoning Link
talentInfo.description: Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

talentInfo.title: Healmonger
talentInfo.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 210 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Final Strike
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

talentInfo.title: Chainsaw
talentInfo.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

talentInfo.title: Pulsing Pain
talentInfo.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Booming Kick
talentInfo.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

talentInfo.title: Lingering Ailment
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Unleashed Potential
talentInfo.description: Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%.  If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

talentInfo.title: Utility Belt
talentInfo.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

talentInfo.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

talentInfo.title: Molten Power

talentInfo.description: When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%.  This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Meteor Bomb

talentInfo.title: Indomitable Resolve
talentInfo.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. Inspire grants Raynor Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Debilitating Rounds
talentInfo.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Penetrating Round from 65 to 45, and its cooldown by 3 seconds. While Inspire is active, Penetrating Round's Slow is increased by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Weak Spot Acquired
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes that are the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper have their Armor reduced by 25 for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Ace in the Hole
talentInfo.description: Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.  Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Exterminator
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active.  Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

talentInfo.title: Veteran Marksman
talentInfo.description: Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%.  Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

talentInfo.title: Seasoned Marksman
talentInfo.description: Quest: Every Minion killed near you grants 0.2 Attack Damage, and Takedowns grant 0.5 Attack Damage.  Reward: Upon gaining 40 bonus Attack Damage, you can also activate Seasoned Marksman to increase your Attack Speed by 40% for 3 seconds. 60 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Behemoth Armor
talentInfo.description: Gain 200 bonus maximum Health.   Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Fight or Flight
talentInfo.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Focused Attack
talentInfo.description: Every 10 seconds, your next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% additional damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Vigorous Assault
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

talentInfo.title: Sustaining Rounds
talentInfo.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

talentInfo.title: Unstable Compound
talentInfo.description: Increase the radius of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Fuel the Rush
talentInfo.description: While Inspire is active, Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks is increased to 2.25 seconds against non-Heroes, and to 4.5 seconds against Heroes.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45.

talentInfo.title: Revolution Overdrive
talentInfo.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while affected by Inspire.  Increase this bonus by 5% for each allied Hero nearby when Inspire is cast.

talentInfo.title: Hamstring Shot
talentInfo.description: Enemies hit by Penetrating Round have a 20% Movement Speed slow for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Heavy Slugs
talentInfo.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Raynor's Raider
talentInfo.description: Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.  The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Hyperion
talentInfo.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Giddy-Up
talentInfo.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

talentInfo.title: Give Me More!
talentInfo.description: While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.  Passive: Increase Adrenaline Rush duration by 0.5 seconds, increasing the total amount healed by 12.5% of Raynor's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Giant Killer
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Steel Resolve
talentInfo.description: Increases Inspire's duration by 50% and causes Adrenaline Rush to also apply Inspire.

talentInfo.title: Executioner
talentInfo.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Line 'Em Up
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bounty Hunter
talentInfo.description: If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds.  Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

talentInfo.title: Rallying Cry
talentInfo.description: Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.  Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

talentInfo.title: Bullseye
talentInfo.description: The first enemy hit by Penetrating Round is stunned for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Paint Them Red
talentInfo.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Scorched Earth
talentInfo.description: An additional set of lasers blast the ground 5 times per second, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage in an area.

talentInfo.title: Nexus Frenzy
talentInfo.description: Increases Attack Speed by 20% and Attack Range by 1.1.

talentInfo.title: Dusk Wings
talentInfo.description: Banshees remain Stealthed while attacking and fire 50% more frequently.

talentInfo.title: Raiders Roll
talentInfo.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

talentInfo.title: Dusk Wing
