talentInfo.description: Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.  Passive: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.

talentInfo.title: Fetid Touch
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.  Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

talentInfo.title: One Good Spread...
talentInfo.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Vigorous Reuptake
talentInfo.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

talentInfo.title: Biotic Armor
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Targeted Excision
talentInfo.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Growing Infestation
talentInfo.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: The Long Pitch
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Massive Shove
talentInfo.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

talentInfo.title: Flailing Swipe
talentInfo.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

talentInfo.title: Virulent Reaction
talentInfo.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: It Hungers
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

talentInfo.title: Poppin' Pustules
talentInfo.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

talentInfo.title: Pox Populi
talentInfo.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Universal Carrier
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Superstrain
talentInfo.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Top Off
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

talentInfo.title: Push Comes To Shove
talentInfo.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bio-Explosion Switch
talentInfo.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230 (+4% per level) damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Controlled Chaos
talentInfo.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range. Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

talentInfo.title: Overwhelming Affliction
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

talentInfo.title: Overflowing Quiver
talentInfo.description: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, a free Withering Fire is shot. This cannot hit Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Dreadful Wake
talentInfo.description: Haunting Wave's application of Black Arrow on Minions and Mercenaries increases the duration to 7 seconds. Haunting Wave restores 5 Mana per Minion or Mercenary hit.

talentInfo.title: Unfurling Shadows
talentInfo.description: Quest: Each time an enemy Hero with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse is hit by Shadow Dagger, its damage is permanently increased by 0.5%.

talentInfo.title: Might of the Banshee Queen
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

talentInfo.title: Unrelenting Torment
talentInfo.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Mercenary Queen
talentInfo.description: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage.  Sylvanas's Basic Attacks Stun and instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to neutral Mercenaries.  Sylvanas deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

talentInfo.title: Unstable Poison
talentInfo.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

talentInfo.title: With the Wind
talentInfo.description: Increases Withering Fire's range by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Possession
talentInfo.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 3 charges.

talentInfo.title: Haunting Arrows
talentInfo.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Lost Soul
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Barbed Shot
talentInfo.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 400% bonus damage.

talentInfo.title: Festering Wounds
talentInfo.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

talentInfo.title: Mind Control
talentInfo.description: After a 1 second cast, take control of an enemy Hero's movement, Silencing them and prevent them from doing anything else. Channel lasts 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Wailing Arrow
talentInfo.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

talentInfo.title: Mind Control
talentInfo.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Windrunner
talentInfo.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

talentInfo.title: Cold Embrace
talentInfo.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Remorseless
talentInfo.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

talentInfo.title: Life Drain
talentInfo.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Evasive Fire
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

talentInfo.title: Will of the Forsaken
talentInfo.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Dark Lady's Call
talentInfo.description: Mind Controlled enemies gain 100% Movement Speed for the duration.

talentInfo.title: Fury of the Storm
talentInfo.description: Every 5 seconds, your next Basic Attack will deal an additional 91 (+4% per level) damage to the target, and 228 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talentInfo.title: Withering Barrage
talentInfo.description: Withering Fire applies Black Arrows, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bolt of the Storm
talentInfo.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

talentInfo.title: Dark Lady's Call
talentInfo.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Bolt of the Storm

talentInfo.title: Templar's Will
talentInfo.description: Quest: Attacking enemy Heroes restores 8 mana per second.  Reward: After spending 30 seconds attacking Heroes, Distortion Beam's damage is increased by 125%.  Reward: After spending 60 seconds attacking Heroes, Distortion Beam's range is increased by an additional 1.

talentInfo.title: Khala's Celerity
talentInfo.description: Plasma Shield also grants 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Mental Acuity
talentInfo.description: Quest: Each Takedown earned lowers the cooldown of Oracle by 3 seconds, to a maximum of 15 seconds.  Reward: Upon getting 5 Takedowns, the sight range of Oracle is increased by 50%.

talentInfo.title: Force Wall
talentInfo.description: Create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.  Passive: Increases the slow amount of Distortion Beam to 35%.

talentInfo.title: Deep Shift

talentInfo.title: Resonation
talentInfo.description: Distortion Beam Slows enemies affected by Psionic Storm by 60%.

talentInfo.title: Psionic Projection
talentInfo.description: Increases the cast range of Plasma Shield and Psionic Storm by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Nullification
talentInfo.description: Activate to reduce the damage the target enemy Hero deals by 75% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Khala's Embrace
talentInfo.description: Increase the Life Steal of Plasma Shield to 75%.

talentInfo.title: Psi-Infusion
talentInfo.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

talentInfo.title: Static Charge
talentInfo.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

talentInfo.title: Khaydarin Amulet
talentInfo.description: Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Plasma Shield
talentInfo.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

talentInfo.title: Electric Fence
talentInfo.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

talentInfo.title: Psionic Echo
talentInfo.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

talentInfo.title: Beam Alignment
talentInfo.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

talentInfo.title: Arc Discharge
talentInfo.description: When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target.  This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

talentInfo.title: Archon
talentInfo.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

talentInfo.title: Black Hole
talentInfo.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Walk
talentInfo.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.  Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

talentInfo.title: Feedback

talentInfo.title: Thermal Lance

talentInfo.title: Executor's Will

talentInfo.title: Crash Lightning
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 4 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost.  Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 15 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces after the initial strike.  Mythic Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning deals 325 additional damage on its bounces, and prioritizes bouncing to enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Maelstrom Weapon
talentInfo.description: Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.  Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

talentInfo.title: Echo of the Elements
talentInfo.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.  Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

talentInfo.title: Frostwolf Pack
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.  Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

talentInfo.title: Feral Resilience
talentInfo.description: Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack.  Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

talentInfo.title: Mana Tide
talentInfo.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Rolling Thunder
talentInfo.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.  For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

talentInfo.title: Ancestral Wrath
talentInfo.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.  Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

talentInfo.title: Sundering
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Earthquake
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

talentInfo.title: Grace Of Air
talentInfo.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

talentInfo.title: Spirit Shield
talentInfo.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

talentInfo.title: Frostwolf's Grace
talentInfo.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

talentInfo.title: Thunderstorm
talentInfo.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

talentInfo.title: Headhunter
talentInfo.description: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2.5%.  Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

talentInfo.title: Boneslicer
talentInfo.description: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores 15 Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

talentInfo.title: Recklessness
talentInfo.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 10% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

talentInfo.title: Voodoo Shuffle
talentInfo.description: Activate to remove Roots and Slows.  Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Troll's Blood
talentInfo.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

talentInfo.title: Arcanite Axes
talentInfo.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

talentInfo.title: Ferocity
talentInfo.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Vicious Assault
talentInfo.description: Increase the duration of Grievous Throw's mark by 3 seconds and its damage bonus by 45%.

talentInfo.title: Taz'dingo!
talentInfo.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

talentInfo.title: Guillotine
talentInfo.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

talentInfo.title: Eye of Zul'jin
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

talentInfo.title: Ensnare
talentInfo.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Lacerate
talentInfo.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time
talentInfo.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

talentInfo.title: Let the Killing Begin
talentInfo.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.  Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

talentInfo.title: No Mercy!
talentInfo.description: Zul'jin's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes marked with Grievous Throw ignore Armor and deal an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage.

talentInfo.title: Amani Resilience
talentInfo.description: Increase Taz'dingo's duration by 1 second. Upon expiring, Zul'jin heals for 50% of the damage he dealt during Taz'dingo.

talentInfo.title: Buzzsaw
talentInfo.description: After impact, Guillotine continues forward, dealing 75% damage to enemies hit. If a Hero is killed by Guillotine, Zul'jin is instantly healed to full.

talentInfo.title: Forest Medicine
talentInfo.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.
